title: Examine bodies only at an authorised school of anatomy
what: Teach anatomy or examine bodies anatomically only at an authorised school of anatomy, under a practice licence.

sources.title: Anatomy Act 1930 (WA)
sources.quote: It shall not be lawful for any person to carry on or teach anatomy at any place or at any place to receive or possess for anatomical examination, or examine anatomically, any deceased person’s body, except at an authorised school of anatomy and under the authority of a practice licence or of a person who holds a practice licence

sources.title: Anatomy Act 1930 (WA)
sources.locator: s 3, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current version)
sources.quote: the Chief Health Officer may grant or renew a practice licence.

reach.condition: if it conducts anatomical examinations of bodies (such as a medical school)
